scientific_integrity: The analytical proof uses Sion minimax, four-constraint extremal rank reduction, and an exact qubit example. Numerical diagnostics do not establish the general result. The priority comparison is best-knowledge; no independent validation or certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional complex Hilbert spaces; two self-adjoint measured observables, one self-adjoint target, absolute expectation-difference tolerances; no assertion for three or more measured observables, nonselfadjoint targets, or infinite-dimensional spaces. The zero-tolerance special case predates this result.
title: Sharp error-budget duality for two-observable numerical information
